group.label: Google Connection (OAuth)
group.comment:
Connect a Google account that has at least Viewer access to your GA4 property — the tools then act as that account.

Setup:
  1. In GCP → APIs & Services → Credentials, create an OAuth client ID of type Web application.
  2. Add the redirect URI shown below to the client's Authorized redirect URIs.
  3. Enable the Google Analytics Data API and Google Analytics Admin API for the project.
  4. Paste the client ID and secret below, Save Config, then click Connect with Google.

field.label: OAuth Client ID
field.comment: The Client ID of your GCP OAuth 2.0 Web-application client.

field.label: OAuth Client Secret
field.comment: The Client secret of the same OAuth client. Stored encrypted at rest.

field.label: Redirect Base URL (optional)
field.comment: Optional. The scheme and host used to build the OAuth redirect URI — e.g. https://abc123.example.com. Leave blank to use this store's base URL. Set it when the admin is reached through a different external host than the store base URL. The exact redirect URI to register in your Google client is shown below.

field.label: Default GA4 Property ID
field.comment: Numeric GA4 property ID (e.g. 123456789). Used when an MCP tool call omits the property_id argument. Discover IDs at runtime by calling google_analytics.account.summaries. Leave blank to require property_id on every call.
